findings.claim: Independent schema discovery found input_readiness_runs, ig_direct_requests_v1 and input_validator_chunk_timings as the relevant timing/request sources.
Among 255 pre-cut runs, curator duration is null/zero/positive in 7/75/173 and validator in 22/99/134.
Positive-only p50/p90 are curator 28,148/115,850.6 ms and validator 78,758.5/257,428.6 ms.
Six pre-cut direct requests map to five distinct runs; none are unfinished and no finished_at precedes requested_at.
Across 493 pre-cut validator chunks, component sums exceed duration_ms in 385 rows, so components cannot safely be assumed additive.
There are 62 same-screen+same-source-snapshot pairs with non-null Curator/Validator durations, but pair identity alone does not establish matched intervention/workload equivalence.

open_world_alternatives: Zeros may be valid zero-cost stages rather than missing telemetry.
Same snapshot pairs may differ in route, family workload, revision or cache reuse.
Chunk component fields may intentionally overlap/nest.
